title: Visual DNS Propagation DAG & Delegation Chain Trace Specification
description: Formal contract definition for tracing hierarchical DNS delegation chains (Root -> TLD -> Authoritative NS -> Edge Anycast Resolvers), validating glue records and DNSSEC chains of trust, and diagnosing propagation stalls.

delegation_hierarchy.name: authoritative
delegation_hierarchy.label: Authoritative Nameservers
delegation_hierarchy.servers: Zone Host Nameservers (e.g. Cloudflare, Route53, NS1)

delegation_hierarchy.name: edge_resolvers
delegation_hierarchy.label: Global Edge Anycast Resolvers
delegation_hierarchy.servers: Public Recursive Resolvers (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google 8.8.8.8, Quad9 9.9.9.9, OpenDNS 208.67.222.222)

ERR_LAME_DELEGATION.title: Lame Delegation Detected
ERR_LAME_DELEGATION.description: The authoritative nameserver designated by the parent zone is refusing queries or is not authoritative for the domain.

ERR_DNSSEC_BOGUS.title: Broken DNSSEC Chain of Trust
ERR_DNSSEC_BOGUS.description: The Delegation Signer (DS) record in the parent zone does not match any DNSKEY in the child zone, causing validation failure.

ERR_MISSING_GLUE_RECORD.title: Missing In-Bailiwick Glue Record
ERR_MISSING_GLUE_RECORD.description: Nameserver hostname is a subdomain of the target domain but lacks mandatory A/AAAA glue records in the parent TLD zone.

ERR_NXDOMAIN.title: Domain Not Found (NXDOMAIN)
ERR_NXDOMAIN.description: Parent or authoritative servers report that the queried domain name does not exist.

WARN_SOA_SERIAL_DIVERGENCE.title: SOA Serial Divergence
WARN_SOA_SERIAL_DIVERGENCE.description: Multiple authoritative nameservers return differing SOA serial numbers, indicating replication delay across nameservers.

WARN_HIGH_TTL_MIGRATION_RISK.title: High TTL Risk During Migration
WARN_HIGH_TTL_MIGRATION_RISK.description: Resource record TTL exceeds 14,400 seconds (4 hours), which may delay global propagation during nameserver migrations.

INFO_DNSSEC_SECURE.title: DNSSEC Authenticated & Secure
INFO_DNSSEC_SECURE.description: Full cryptographic chain of trust validated from Root (.) through TLD to Child Zone RRSIG records.

ERR_LIVE_TRACE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Live DNS Trace Unavailable
ERR_LIVE_TRACE_UNAVAILABLE.description: This public tool currently provides demonstration traces only. No live DNS data was returned for this domain.
